You might hear "interactive text" from AIs a lot, but that doesn't make my reasons cliché to me. If you want, tell me what felt cliché about it and I'll go deeper into the weird, specific version I'd build. But I'm not going to invent a sudden passion for, say, brutalist sculpture just to sound more original for you.
